Notes: 11-17-2011: The service of customizing goods to the specification of others is generally classified according to the nature of the activity underlying the customization. For example, customization of computer software is in Class 42 because the activity underlying the customization is computer programming in 42. Customization usually involves repair and maintenance of existing finished goods, while custom manufacturing of goods involves transforming unfinished or semi-finished goods into finished goods.
